notes.title: Bug Fix - V1
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

There's a short term simple fix for the level not finishing/loading bug if you encounter it,
Restart the game, once restarted it should work, sometimes the first boot of the game doesn't work. 

We are looking into consistently replicating the bug and fixing it,

Thank you,

Vox Studios
